name: SideSheet
title: Components/Surfaces/SideSheet
description: The title and close control share the first header row. Optional `headerActions` appear below alongside result navigation; `actions` remains a compatible alias. Optional `footer` actions remain visible outside the scrollable body. Fundamental and Fundamental Floating share the same content and interactions.
purpose: Open record details while preserving the queue behind them.
usage: Header actions align with the title and close button. Footer actions and previous/next navigation support longer review workflows; docked mode is optional.

props.name: headerActions
props.description: Optional calls to action below the title row, alongside result navigation.

props.name: position
props.description: One-based position within the current filtered result set.

props.name: resizable
props.description: Allow pointer and keyboard resizing from the left edge on desktop.

props.name: actionsRef
props.description:
A ref to imperative actions.
- `unmount`: Ends the closing phase of the dialog after an externally controlled closing animation finishes.
Call `preventUnmountOnClose()` in `onOpenChange` first, otherwise the dialog completes closing on its own.
Whether it leaves the DOM is decided by `keepMounted` on the portal.
- `close`: Closes the dialog imperatively when called.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description:
Whether the dialog is initially open.

To render a controlled dialog, use the `open` prop instead.

props.name: defaultTriggerId
props.description:
ID of the trigger that the dialog is associated with.
This is useful in conjunction with the `defaultOpen` prop to create an initially open dialog.

props.name: disablePointerDismissal
props.description:
Whether to prevent the dialog from closing on outside presses.
For non-modal dialogs, this also prevents the dialog from closing when focus moves outside of it.

props.name: handle
props.description:
A handle to associate the dialog with a trigger.
If specified, allows external triggers to control the dialog's open state.
Can be created with the Dialog.createHandle() method.

props.name: onOpenChangeComplete
props.description: Event handler called after any animations complete when the dialog is opened or closed.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is currently open.

props.name: triggerId
props.description:
ID of the trigger that the dialog is associated with.
This is useful in conjunction with the `open` prop to create a controlled dialog.
There's no need to specify this prop when the dialog is uncontrolled (that is, when the `open` prop is not set).
